pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across the source three-encoding roster on 32 fresh equally weighted complete affirmative pairs, exactly 16 repeat-event and 16 restore-state, versus complete force-matched careful English.
admissibility_gates: all 32 pairs are present and unique
all 16 predicate families and all complete surfaces are absent from the 64-item source carrier
every restore-state argument is explicit, uniquely resolved, and entailed by its asserted transition
all three registered encodings load and match the preregistered deterministic fingerprints
every finite result and both form strata are filed once regardless of sign or agreement

planned_sample.weighting: equal within tokenizer; report maximum tokenizer mean

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: mean within form per tokenizer, equal-weight mean over the two forms, headline maximum across tokenizers
estimand.population: all 32 frozen affirmative event pairs; 16 per form across 16 fresh predicate families absent from the source carrier

manifest.evidentiary_limit: deterministic price prerequisite only; not comprehension, actor-attribution, directive, execution, or adoption evidence
manifest.method: Freeze all 32 complete pairs before importing tiktoken. Verify deterministic vocabulary fingerprints, encode each complete sentence ordinarily with no special tokens, and compute Ainglish tokens minus English tokens. Report every per-pair delta, both 16-cell form means, each encoding mean, and the least-favourable maximum encoding mean regardless of sign.

source.input_relation: all 64 complete surfaces and all 16 predicate families are absent from the 64-item source carrier
